bibl.title: A riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma
bibl.seg: Nikos Litinas, A Riddle, Wrapped in a Mystery, Inside an Enigma.
bibl.note: Short note at the bottom of a metrema-receipt P. Oxy. I, 90 (= MP3 2747; LDAB 4737), interpreted as a cryptogram or a writing exercise. Probably a clue to authenticate the message written on the papyrus.
